title: The normalized root stalk maximal ideal is principal independently of ramification
statement: Let H be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], g a nonzerodivisor, H/(g) a domain, n>0, A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], V=D(g). Assume N locally Noetherian. Let p:P->V be finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism] and a=p followed by V->N. Assume its relative normalization finite [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. At x of the normalization with image prime (t), assume the base stalk regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Then the maximal ideal of the normalized stalk C is principal. No generator is specified and no tame bound or torsor structure is required.

proof.text: Put s=a.fromNormalization(x) and R=O(N,s). Regularity makes R a domain by [lem-sc-regular-local-domain]. The monic polynomial X^n-g makes A free, hence flat over H. Flatness preserves regularity of multiplication by g. Localize this at s; t^n=g shows that the image of t is nonzero. The displayed prime equality and Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal identify the local maximal ideal with the span of that image of t. Apply [lem-sc-principal-ideal-dvr], then transport along StructureSheaf.stalkIso. Thus R is a DVR and has dimension one by [lem-sc-dvr-dimension-one].

Prove the private normal_stalk_over_dvr by base change along X.fromSpecStalk(s), retaining the identity pullback used by [lem-sbc-normalization-stalk-base-change]. Its base is isomorphic to Spec R, an integral scheme whose stalks are integrally closed localizations of the DVR R. The base-changed finite etale cover is smooth over this base. On standard smooth affine charts apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-over-normal-ring-normal], and transport normality from prime localizations to stalks. Apply [lem-sbc-relative-normalization-normal-stalks] to obtain normal domain stalks of its relative normalization.

The comparison isomorphism of [lem-sbc-normalization-stalk-base-change] identifies the localized normalization with the pullback of the original normalization. Lift the closed point of Spec O(a.normalization,x) to that pullback using SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk. The projection is a flat preimmersion, as a base change of the stalk morphism; hence its local stalk map is faithfully flat and injective, and is surjective by the preimmersion property. RingEquiv.ofBijective gives an isomorphism from the original stalk to this normal stalk. Transport domainhood and integral closedness across the two ring equivalences.

Finiteness of a.fromNormalization makes its source locally Noetherian over N and its stalk map quasi-finite. Algebra.QuasiFinite.eq_of_le_of_under_eq makes contraction strictly monotone on prime spectra; Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono therefore bounds the normalized stalk dimension by dim R=1. Apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_isIntegrallyClosed from [lem-sc-normal-dim1-dvr]. The regular-local cotangent dimension identity and Mathlib IsLocalRing.finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff give principalness of the maximal ideal, also allowing the field case. No separable field-factor decomposition or ramification calculation is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0307, 035L and 00PD; smooth normal ascent is Tag 033C. Lean proof uses the stalk comparison and normal-stalk declarations, flat preimmersion stalk isomorphisms, and quasi-finite incomparability.

from.place: Separate principalness and valuation-one steps of the root-normalization calculation

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_stalk_maximalIdeal_isPrincipal
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (g : H)
    (hg : IsSMulRegular H g) [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    ∀ (P : Scheme.{u}) (p : P ⟶ V.toScheme) (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)} →
      IsRegularLocalRing (N.presheaf.stalk (a.fromNormalization x)) →
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x)).IsPrincipal
